Design principles

Useful before impressive

Every proposed system should answer a real comfort, safety or resource need.

Secure by design

Access, connectivity, updates and privacy need review before a system is specified.

People stay in control

Automation should be understandable, adjustable and able to fail gracefully.

Explore architecture with intelligence

Technology should belong
to the life of the home.
